messages:
dan: Heads up — we're scheduling an image credential rotation & keystore expiry remediation this week. Need to coordinate RBAC, KMS usage, and audit logging. Impacted: runtime image pulls, cosign signatures, and a couple of operator service accounts. Any blockers?
priya: Which clusters/services are in scope? can we get a short list so I can prepare IAM/RBAC deltas?
omar: In-scope: api-prod, ingestion-prod, and dedicated-dedicated-gpu pools. Key rotation needs HSM wrap keys; cosign signer will switch to new key material. We should avoid rolling the keystore and image creds simultaneously for the same service.
kelly: Agree on staggered rollout. Proposed plan: 1) Publish new cosign key to KMS 2) Update RBAC so only signer SA can call kms:AsymmetricSign 3) Canary cosign verification on staging 4) Rotate image tags and pull creds on canary 5) Force rollout to prod if canary green.
dan: Sounds good. Also need to confirm audit logs capture key ops. priya can you add KMS audit forwarding for these keys to our long-term audit bucket? we need events: Encrypt/Decrypt/AsymmetricSign/AsymmetricVerify and IAM grants.
priya: Yep. I'll add the KMS key resource to the audit sink and create an IAM role binding change. Snippet I'll push to the PR: `gcloud logging sinks create audit-rotation-sink gs://redwood-audit-rotations --log-filter="resource.type=cloud_kms_keyring OR protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign"`
audit-bot: policy-change: rbac_modification detected for resource //projects/redwood/roles/SignerRole by priya at 2026-03-20T09:12:21Z.
omar: Two operational notes: - Make sure runtime nodes have an updated KMS client that can rotate keys without restarting services (use token refresh) - Add a KV-prefetch to avoid cold-start decrypt spikes.
kelly: For rollback, let's keep old keys active for 48 hours and mark them deprecated. We'll remove after 7 days. Also create a canary checklist: `- verify cosign verify` `- verify image pull with rotated secret` `- check audit logs for AsymmetricSign events`
dan: Who can own the RBAC PR? I can prototype but will need priya to review IAM. Also we should notify SRE oncall for rollout window.
priya: I'll own the RBAC PR and add the audit forwarding change. tagging @sre-oncall in the schedule. PR will include this policy diff: `- members: ["group:old-signers@redwood.com"] + members: ["serviceAccount:cosign-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]`
audit-bot: deploy-note: audit sink update planned, awaiting manual approval.
dan: Ok — timeline: draft PR today, canary deploy tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC, prod rollout Thursday 02:00-06:00 UTC. If anyone has objections raise now, otherwise I'll open the PR and ping SRE.
omar: Add a short smoke test that queries audit logs after canary: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"AsymmetricSign\" AND resource.labels.key_id=\"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rotation/cryptoKeys/cosign\"" --limit 10`
kelly: I'll prepare the canary playbook (rollback commands, expected log lines, cosign verify examples).
dan: Thanks all. I'll open the thread PR and tag reviewers. If we see any unexpected KMS permission errors during canary, we'll pause and revert image creds.
priya: Noted — will monitor and set an alert for `kms.*` admin errors and audit sink delivery failures.
audit-bot: alert-config: created monitor kms-rotation-errors with threshold 1/min for 10m.
dan: Great — wrapping up. Will post PR link in this thread once ready.
